settings.headline: Trash and recycling
settings.subtitle: Trash goes out once a week and recycling every other week, on the same day. Put carts at the curb by 7 am, handles facing the house and three feet apart.

settings.headline: Find your pickup day
settings.intro: Your zone is printed on your utility bill. Not sure? Call Public Works at (555) 010-4200.

settings.headline: Holiday schedule changes
settings.intro: Collection moves back one day for the rest of the week after a holiday that falls on a weekday.

rows.change: Thursday and Friday routes move to Friday and Saturday

items.q: My cart was missed. What do I do?
items.a: Report it by 5 pm the next working day through the 311 service, and a truck will come back. Check first that the cart was out by 7 am.

items.q: How do I get a new or bigger cart?
items.a: Call Public Works at (555) 010-4200. A second trash cart is $6.50 a month; recycling carts are free.

items.q: Where do I take paint, oil and batteries?
items.a: Bring them to the household hazardous waste collection day on Saturday, October 24, at the Public Works yard, 900 Industrial Blvd.
